## RE:volution Mod v1.2.5

v1.2.5 introduces the Rune Progression Foundation and aligns rune rank, awakening, server validation, and GUI behavior around one progression model.

### Added
- Added centralized rune progression rules for the three supported ranks: Ordinary, Improved, and Advanced.
- Added reusable awakening decisions with explicit rejection reasons for invalid collections, missing runes, maximum rank, and collections that are not ready for the next awakening step.
- Added regression coverage for progression transitions, incomplete collections, inventory awakening decisions, and rank limits.
- Added rune rank information to tooltips and visual rank markers: no marker for Ordinary, white for Improved, and gold for Advanced.
- Added resource icons to currency, rune-resource, and rune-purchase price rows.
- Added rune GUI preloading so the collection, deck state, and player economy data are prepared before the screen is shown.

### Fixed
- Server awakening checks now use the shared progression rules instead of duplicating rank validation.
- Client awakening availability now matches the server-side collection gate.
- The legacy `upgrade_rune:` network action remains compatible but continues to perform awakening; v1.2.5 does not add a separate paid upgrade mechanic.
- Opening the rune GUI no longer briefly shows an incorrect purchase state before the collection arrives.
- Rune purchases no longer replace the purchase button with a temporary loading state after each purchase.
- Purchase price rendering is settled before drawing, removing the one-frame price shift during repeated purchases.
- Rune economy panels no longer overlap the legacy resource block, and tooltip rendering no longer darkens or flickers the translucent panels.
- The awakening hint now correctly shows the left mouse button.

### Other
- Awakening remains free in v1.2.5; paid awakening is not enabled by this release.
- The progression lifecycle remains collection-based: awakening promotes the selected rune to the next rank, consumes runes at the current collection rank, and preserves already higher-ranked runes.
- A full Advanced collection remains the maximum progression state.
- Existing configurable rune purchase pricing and duplicate compensation from v1.2.4 remain unchanged.
- Manual runtime validation covered GUI preloading, repeated purchases, purchase-price stability, rank tooltips/markers, resource panels, collection limits, and awakening behavior.
- Current full-collection/awakening and partial-collection/purchase GUI states were captured for the release documentation.
- Feature, develop, and main CI validation completed successfully before release preparation.
- Updated the mod version metadata to `1.2.5`.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.5.jar` on both client and server.

Compatible resource pack: [RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0), available in 64x64 and 128x128 variants.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.4...v1.2.5](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.4...v1.2.5)
